---
title: "Tutorial 14B — Self-check answers"
sidebar: mfml
---

1. The final classification (or task) head; keep the convolutional backbone.
2. Feature extraction / linear probing of a frozen representation.
3. Pretrained filters are already useful; large steps risk destroying them (catastrophic forgetting).
4. Domain shift too large, or target data so abundant that scratch training catches up / mismatches preprocessing.
5. Train the new head with backbone frozen, then unfreeze (top) backbone layers and fine-tune with small $\eta$.
